items.q: Look! A whale ______ right next to our boat!
items.vi: Nhìn kìa! Một con cá voi đang bơi ngay cạnh thuyền của chúng ta!
items.explanation: Look! points to something happening at this moment, so the present continuous is swimming is needed; the present simple, past simple and present perfect do not describe an action in progress now.

items.q: Lan ______ the early bus to the beach because she woke up late.
items.vi: Lan lỡ chuyến xe buýt sớm ra biển vì cô ấy dậy muộn.
items.explanation: You miss a bus or train when you arrive too late to catch it. You lose an object or a match, you fail an exam, and you drop something you are holding.

items.q: The boat trip was cancelled because of ______ winds along the coast.
items.vi: Chuyến đi thuyền bị hủy vì gió mạnh dọc bờ biển.
items.explanation: Wind that blows with great force is strong wind. Heavy collocates with rain and snow, while hard and big do not go with wind.

items.q: The hotel was lovely, and the free boat trip to the island was ______.
items.vi: Khách sạn rất đẹp, và chuyến đi thuyền miễn phí ra đảo là phần thưởng tuyệt vời thêm vào.
items.explanation: The icing on the cake is something extra that makes a good situation even better. The tip of the iceberg is a small visible part of a big problem, a piece of cake is something very easy, and the last straw is the final problem that makes you lose patience.

items.q: Let's stay inside the tent until the storm ______.
items.vi: Chúng ta hãy ở trong lều cho đến khi cơn bão qua đi.
items.explanation: A storm or an argument blows over when it passes and ends. Blow up means to explode, blow out is what you do to a candle, and a car or machine breaks down when it stops working.

items.q: The dog ______ the gate open by itself; it was locked all night.
items.vi: Con chó không thể nào tự đẩy cổng mở được; cổng đã bị khóa suốt đêm.
items.explanation: Can't have + past participle says we are sure something did NOT happen in the past. Mustn't have is not used for past deduction, shouldn't have criticises an action that did happen, and needn't have means it was unnecessary.

items.q: The whole class passed the chemistry test, ______ the teacher very proud.
items.vi: Cả lớp đều đậu bài kiểm tra Hóa, điều đó khiến cô giáo rất tự hào.
items.explanation: After a comma, which can refer back to the WHOLE previous clause (the fact that the class passed), so , which made is correct. That cannot follow a comma in this way, what does not refer back to a clause, and who is only for people.

items.q: Our school team ______ the visitors 3–1 in the final of the eco-quiz.
items.vi: Đội trường mình đã thắng đội khách 3–1 trong trận chung kết cuộc thi đố vui về môi trường.
items.explanation: You beat a person or a team (the opponent). You win a match or a prize, and you gain or achieve something such as experience or a goal, never an opponent.

items.q: By next summer, my family ______ every beach in Da Nang.
items.vi: Đến mùa hè năm sau, gia đình tôi sẽ đi hết mọi bãi biển ở Đà Nẵng.
items.explanation: By + a future time marks an action completed before that point, so the future perfect will have visited is used; the simple future, present perfect and present continuous do not show completion by a deadline.

items.q: Don't worry about lunch – Mum has packed ______ sandwiches for the whole group.
items.vi: Đừng lo về bữa trưa – mẹ đã gói rất nhiều bánh mì kẹp cho cả nhóm rồi.
items.explanation: Plenty of (more than enough) is used with BOTH plural countable nouns like sandwiches and uncountable nouns. Much, a great deal of and a large amount of go only with uncountable nouns.

items.q: Before our trip to Australia, Dad spent every evening ______ his English.
items.vi: Trước chuyến đi Úc, bố dành mỗi tối để ôn lại tiếng Anh.
items.explanation: Spend time + -ing: spent every evening brushing up on (improving his knowledge again). An infinitive, a base form or a past form cannot follow spend time.

items.q: We ______ hundreds of photos of the elephants at the sanctuary.
items.vi: Chúng tôi đã chụp hàng trăm bức ảnh về những con voi ở khu bảo tồn.
items.explanation: In English you take a photo. Make, do and catch do not collocate with photo.

items.q: The zoo's plan to breed rare parrots ended in ______ when none of the eggs hatched.
items.vi: Kế hoạch nhân giống vẹt quý hiếm của sở thú đã thất bại khi không quả trứng nào nở.
items.explanation: A plan that does not achieve its aim ends in failure. A defeat is being beaten by an opponent in a contest, a loss is something you no longer have, and a mistake is a wrong action, not a result.

items.q: Living in the city centre is exciting; ______, the rent costs a fortune.
items.vi: Sống ở trung tâm thành phố rất thú vị; mặt khác, tiền thuê nhà thì đắt khủng khiếp.
items.explanation: On the other hand presents the opposite side of a situation (exciting, but expensive). In addition adds a similar point, as a result shows a consequence, and for instance gives an example.

items.q: Choosing where to go on holiday usually ______ how much money you have.
items.vi: Việc chọn đi nghỉ ở đâu thường quy về chuyện bạn có bao nhiêu tiền.
items.explanation: Something boils down to one thing when that thing is the real deciding factor. Boil over is what milk does on the stove, break down means to stop working, and put up with means to tolerate.

items.q: You ______ bring a tent; the campsite lends them to visitors for free.
items.vi: Bạn không cần mang lều; khu cắm trại cho khách mượn miễn phí.
items.explanation: Needn't means it is not necessary, which fits the reason given. Mustn't and can't express prohibition or impossibility, and shouldn't gives advice against something.

items.q: My family ______ in this fishing village since my grandfather was a boy.
items.vi: Gia đình tôi đã sống ở làng chài này từ khi ông tôi còn là một cậu bé.
items.explanation: Since + a past time with a situation that continues up to now takes the present perfect have lived; the present simple, past simple and present continuous do not link the past starting point to the present.

items.q: Lan wishes she ______ her camera to the bird park yesterday.
items.vi: Lan ước gì hôm qua cô ấy đã mang máy ảnh đến công viên chim.
items.explanation: A regret about the past (yesterday) uses wish + past perfect: had brought. Wish + past simple is for a present situation, and the present perfect and would are not used after wish here.

items.q: It took the campers three ______ to light the fire in the wet forest.
items.vi: Những người cắm trại phải thử đến ba lần mới nhóm được lửa trong khu rừng ẩm ướt.
items.explanation: An attempt is one act of trying to do something, so you count three attempts. Effort is the energy you use, a trial is a scientific or legal test, and a test checks knowledge or quality.

items.q: The beach ______ we camped last year is now closed to protect the sea turtles.
items.vi: Bãi biển nơi chúng tôi cắm trại năm ngoái nay đã đóng cửa để bảo vệ rùa biển.
items.explanation: Where replaces a place adverb (we camped there). Which and that would need a preposition (on which), and whom is only for people.

items.q: The showers at the campsite were not ______, so we complained to the owner.
items.vi: Nhà tắm ở khu cắm trại không đạt yêu cầu, nên chúng tôi đã phàn nàn với chủ khu.
items.explanation: Up to scratch means of an acceptable standard. Up in the air means still undecided, up in arms means very angry about something, and under the weather means slightly ill.

items.q: ______ had we reached the campsite when it began to pour with rain.
items.vi: Chúng tôi vừa mới tới khu cắm trại thì trời bắt đầu mưa như trút nước.
items.explanation: Hardly + had + subject + past participle ... when means one thing happened immediately after another. No sooner pairs with than, not when, and not until and only when need a full clause before the inversion.

items.q: The guide told us to ______ a close eye on our bags at the night market.
items.vi: Hướng dẫn viên bảo chúng tôi để mắt kỹ tới túi xách của mình ở chợ đêm.
items.explanation: The fixed expression is keep an eye on something (watch it carefully). Hold, take and put do not form this collocation with eye.

items.q: Mai ______ her passport twice before she finally found it in her coat pocket.
items.vi: Mai đã kiểm tra hộ chiếu hai lần trước khi cuối cùng tìm thấy nó trong túi áo khoác.
items.explanation: The checking happened before another past action (she found it), so the past perfect had checked is needed; the present tenses cannot describe an earlier past event.

items.q: The baby turtle ______ to reach the sea before the seagulls noticed it.
items.vi: Chú rùa con đã tìm được cách ra tới biển trước khi lũ mòng biển phát hiện.
items.explanation: Manage to + verb means to succeed in doing something difficult. Succeed needs in + -ing, and achieve and reach take a noun object (a goal, a place), not a to-infinitive.
